text:
Introduction
This procedure outlines the checklist I1, which must be performed on an annual 
bases as indicated Y1 in the above titled block. 
The first draft initiated by eng. Mostafa Abd_Alla Beni Suef East 220kv Substation 
and approved at 15 Jan 2002.
Safety 
Precautions
Work
 permit must be issued.
Isolator
 switch must be isolated and grounded.
Wear
 proper safety equipment "belt, shoes,...,etc".
Change
 remote switch to local position.
Tools and Equipments
Safety equipment "belt,
 shoes,...,etc".
Blower, tool set, Vaseline, and 
 chlorate solvent
Work to be Carried Out
Clean interior
 of the control panel to remove any accumulated dust and dirt.
Perform
 operation check both from remote and local control.
Quarterly
 operation (two 0-C cycles)
Clean
 porcelain insulators.
Cleaning the
 electrical contacts with a chlorate solvent followed by Vaseline coating.
Check control
 wiring for losses.
Tighten all
 electrical connections.
Check all
 ground connections for continuity.
Check the main
 electrical connections for any losses bolts at the terminals.
Check on/of
 indications.
